column1: # Slice 307 (CALL-WHOLE-ARGUMENTS-STRUCTURE), try a17 -- a16 with the fix of the first frontend translation of a16 (fe170i translated the
# helpers, lower and core modules and refused emit: "assignment value has incompatible type" at emit.lm2:16274:40, the const body of
# lm_compiler_merge_scan passed to lm_compiler_merge_lift, which takes the body it inserts into without const): the argument is cast as the
# module casts the fields of a const body. The a16 fix: the four field accesses passed as arguments in the new lower functions cast
# (lm_compiler_emit_lifted, lm_compiler_whole_applicable). The a15 fixes: the locals and parameters named node in the five new functions
# renamed at, the local call of lm_compiler_merge_lift_find renamed appl. The a14 fix: a duplicated condition line in
# lm_compiler_whole_decide removed. The a13 fixes: the LIFTED and DEFERRED marks on the frame flag bits 65536 and 131072, merge rejected as a
# call head, the hidden declaration name allocated zeroed and no trailer written on the hidden body, the four helper functions exported in
# tools/build.lm2 (frontend_names 264). The remainders of the review of Codex over a11 (a12): the hold of the overlapping readings
# (whole_overlap_held), the names and the form of a whole call before the actual in both executors (lmx_call_bind_whole_form), the merge
# written in the call itself lifted into a hidden declaration (THEN operand 66, OP_COUNT 67), the applicability by the Consumer-relative
# projection with the conversion table. The kernel, the driver and tools/build.lm2 unchanged since a13 (tool170d and rt170e stay). Run by
# `lmxtool steps` with the working tool of boot164a.
